title: God Chooses David
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks closer to see what something really is, and tonight Samuel learns to look past tall brothers to the heart of the youngest: Scout looks past a scruffy new boy's old clothes and finds a kind friend.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout always looks closer to see what something really is. In Scout’s world today: a new boy comes to class in a too-big shirt and shoes with holes in them. Some kids whisper and laugh. Scout looks closer. He sees the new boy share his crayons with the girl who forgot hers. At recess Scout sits by him, and the boy tells the funniest stories Scout has ever heard. Just like Samuel at Jesse’s house, Scout learned to look past the outside and see the heart, the way Heavenly Father does.
